description: 1 double bedroom, 2 single bedrooms, 1 full bathroom with bathtub and shower, 1 WC, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Double-aspect apartment, windows on two facades. Kitchen island present, hob on island facing dining table and living area. Cook at island faces the room, suited to cooking while entertaining or supervising children. Wall counter provides additional storage and workspace. Living arrangement: split, seating area on left, kitchen island and dining on right. Dining table visible, approximately 6 seats. Bathroom config: 1 full bathroom with bathtub and shower; 1 WC-only room. Parallel morning routines possible. Double bedroom (15.4sqm) and 2 single bedrooms (14.5sqm and 11.5sqm) all from central corridor, no en-suite. 1 of 2 single bedrooms has a desk visible. Both large enough for bunk bed. Possible configurations, mutually exclusive: (1) two children's bedrooms; (2) one children's bedroom and one home office; (3) two home offices; (4) one or both as guest rooms; (5) bunk bed in one or both. Cannot simultaneously provide two children's bedrooms and a home office without bunk bed. Storage room in corridor zone, suitable for coats, bikes, laundry or utility storage, not adjacent to kitchen. Entry from top. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits families with one or two children, households working from home, people who cook while entertaining.
not_suitable_for: two children's bedrooms and home office simultaneously without bunk bed
